name: UPPER WALKWAY WALL
text: The metal plates are stained with years of
runoff from the level above. A rusted pipe
still clings to the surface, going nowhere.

name: RIGHT ALLEY WALL
text: Stark grey paneling forms the boundary of this
sector. Pipes run down its length,
disappearing into the floor grates.

name: NOODLE STAND
text: Warm light spills from the open doorway of
this patched-together stall. Bowls and cooking
implements are crammed onto every available
surface.

name: LEFT ALLEY WALL
text: Industrial conduits run along the dull metal
surface. A small access panel glows faintly
near the base.

name: LOWER LEFT BALCONY
text: A sturdy metal railing guards the edge of the
walkway. An exhaust unit hums quietly beneath
the floor plating.

name: PRODUCE STALL DISPLAY
text: Wooden crates are stacked high beneath a
makeshift awning. They hold a meager selection
of bright, synthetic-looking vegetables.

name: LOWER RIGHT BALCONY
text: The railing overlooks a deeper level of the
sector. A heavy ventilation fan sits in the
corner, caked in grime.

name: RIGHT PRODUCE DISPLAY
text: Shelves built from scrap wood hold small piles
of scavenged greens. A patched blue tarp
provides a little shade.

name: LARGE PUDDLE
text: Stagnant water reflects the neon glow from the
signs above. It smells faintly of ozone and
old cooking oil.

name: UPPER VENTILATION SHAFT
text: A heavy metal duct disappears into the
ceiling. It looks like it hasn't been cleaned
since the settlement was founded.

name: THICK POWER CABLE
text: A heavy, insulated cable snakes across the
ground, connecting the noodle stand to a jury-
rigged power source.

name: RUSTED WALL PIPE
text: This thick pipe elbows into the concrete wall.
The joints are heavily corroded.

name: VERTICAL CONDUIT PIPE
text: A long, scarred pipe runs vertically down the
side of the building. It's secured by heavy
metal brackets.

name: SMALL PUDDLE
text: A shallow pool of murky water has collected in
a dip in the paving stones. The warm light
from the noodle stand barely reaches it.
